concept: Website, email, domain and hosting as four breakers in one made-up breaker box on a plum wall, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side three ways, the box changing. Whole, door open: the yellow lever over EMAIL is down. Right up against the chart inside the door, Who to ring: Kev's lad, 2019; came with the wifi?; Sue (Sue's left); no idea. Then close from below: all four levers up under a yellow Nexulabs sticker. Plum, white plastic, charcoal and one lemon yellow.
